title: UP Scholarship Online Form 2026-27
vacancyDetails: Online scholarship applications for eligible UP students for academic year 2026-27
qualification: As per scheme (class / course and category criteria on scholarship portal)
applicationFee: No application fee for most schemes (verify on portal)
selectionProcess: Online application → Institute / District verification → Scholarship disbursement
documentsRequired: Aadhaar, income certificate, caste certificate if applicable, bank passbook, educational documents, domicile
howToApply:
1. Visit https://scholarship.up.gov.in
2. Register / login as student
3. Select scheme and fill form
4. Upload documents and submit
5. Track status after institute verification
shortDescription: UP Scholarship Online Form 2026-27. Apply for Pre/Post Matric and other schemes at scholarship.up.gov.in.
content:
The Uttar Pradesh Scholarship portal has opened / updated applications for session 2026-27.

Eligible students should apply online, complete e-KYC if required, and ensure school/college verification within the last date.
